entries.title: Your other computers update by themselves
entries.body: When this computer has a newer Infinitary, a computer that runs work for it now gets the same version as soon as it connects, with nothing for you to click. Its running work pauses for a moment and carries on after. You still get a card to update it when Infinitary needs something from you there, such as a password, or when an update does not go through.
entries.noPicture: Nothing new appears on screen: the card that asked to update the computer no longer comes up when the app can update it by itself.
